# MB Prime Projects

> Premium real estate developer in Andhra Pradesh, India — villa plots, gated communities, and residential projects in Srikakulam, Vizianagaram, Vijayawada, and Amaravati.

MB Prime Projects ("MB Prime") builds and markets luxury villas, open plots, and planned residential communities. The official website is https://mbprimeprojects.com. For enquiries: +91 9088456 999, mbprimeprojects@gmail.com.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://mbprimeprojects.com/): Overview of MB Prime and featured developments across Andhra Pradesh
- [All Projects](https://mbprimeprojects.com/projects): Portfolio of active and upcoming real estate projects
- [MB Prime Villas — Srikakulam](https://mbprimeprojects.com/projects/mb-prime-villas): Premium villa plots in Srikakulam; 70-acre gated community with 25+ amenities
- [MB Prime Enclave — Vizianagaram](https://mbprimeprojects.com/projects/mb-prime-enclave): Premium open plots in Vizianagaram
- [Prime Jewel City — Vijayawada](https://mbprimeprojects.com/projects/prime-jewel-city): Residential plots and towers in Vijayawada
- [Capital West — Vijayawada](https://mbprimeprojects.com/projects/capital-west): Premium villas and plots in Vijayawada
- [AI Gen Serenity Villas — Amaravati](https://mbprimeprojects.com/projects/ai-gen-serenity-villas): Luxury villas in Amaravati
- [About Us](https://mbprimeprojects.com/about-us): Company background and development philosophy
- [Founder](https://mbprimeprojects.com/founder): Maganti Babu, CEO & Founder of MB Prime Projects
